scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace backend" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run test --workspace frontend && npm run test --workspace backend
scripts.lint: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run lint --workspace frontend && npm run lint --workspace backend
scripts.android:sync: npm run android:assets && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:prepare: npm run build --workspace frontend && npm run android:sync
scripts.android:debug-apk: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path android\\gradlew.bat) { Set-Location android; .\\gradlew.bat assembleDebug } else { throw 'Android platform not added yet. Run npm run android:add first.' }"
scripts.android:release-bundle: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path android\\gradlew.bat) { Set-Location android; .\\gradlew.bat bundleRelease } else { throw 'Android platform not added yet. Run npm run android:add first.' }"
scripts.android:release-apk: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path android\\gradlew.bat) { Set-Location android; .\\gradlew.bat assembleRelease } else { throw 'Android platform not added yet. Run npm run android:add first.' }"
scripts.android:internal-testing:prepare: npm run build && npm run android:sync && npm run android:release-bundle
